name: presentations
description: Real deck production: PPTX presentations, pitch decks, diagrams and SVG assets.

commands.name: deck
commands.template: Create a real PPTX pitch deck for: {input}. Use create_pptx_deck/create_pitch_deck and deliver slides with a clear story arc.

commands.name: outline
commands.template: Build a slide-by-slide outline for: {input}. Name the audience, the story arc, the evidence per slide and the ask; no slide text yet.

commands.name: notes
commands.description: Write speaker notes for a deck
commands.template: Write speaker notes for the deck about: {input}. One note block per slide, with evidence and a transition; flag missing facts instead of inventing them.

changelog: 1.1.0 - DoD pass: skill pack with two examples, commands, changelog and README entry.
